name: Light Dahi Papdi Chaat
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: Papdi: ½ cup whole-wheat flour, ¼ tsp ajwain, 1 tsp oil, salt, water
1 cup plain low-fat yogurt, whisked until smooth
1 small onion and 1 tomato, finely chopped
Mint chutney and 1 tsp tamarind pulp (no added sugar)
½ tsp each roasted cumin and chaat masala
steps: Knead the papdi dough, roll thin, cut into rounds and prick with a fork. Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until crisp; cool.
Mix the chickpeas, potato, onion and tomato.
Arrange the papdi on plates, top with the chickpea mix and spoon over the yogurt.
Drizzle with mint chutney and tamarind pulp.
Sprinkle with cumin, chaat masala, coriander and pomegranate.
note: Baked whole-wheat papdi, no sweet chutney and a chickpea topping make this a higher-protein version.
